queries.description:
Named queries selectable by the `query` verb, keyed by the name typed as its
first argument. Nested arbitrarily deep: each additional argument descends one
level, and every level's `query` arguments are appended in order.

query.description:
Arguments passed verbatim to stern when this level is selected, e.g. a pod
regex plus flags. Concatenated with every ancestor level's arguments, so a
nested entry refines its parent rather than replacing it.

queries.description:
Further queries nested under this one, selected by appending their name as
another argument.
